message_ledger_delta_matches_kind.name: message_ledger_delta_matches_kind
message_ledger_delta_matches_kind.value:
("message_ledger_entries"."entry_kind" = 'grant' and "message_ledger_entries"."package_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."delta" > 0 and "message_ledger_entries"."message_event_id" is null and "message_ledger_entries"."original_entry_id" is null)
      or ("message_ledger_entries"."entry_kind" = 'debit' and "message_ledger_entries"."package_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."delta" = -1 and "message_ledger_entries"."message_event_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."original_entry_id" is null)
      or ("message_ledger_entries"."entry_kind" = 'free' and "message_ledger_entries"."delta" = 0 and "message_ledger_entries"."message_event_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."original_entry_id" is null)
      or ("message_ledger_entries"."entry_kind" = 'compensation' and "message_ledger_entries"."package_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."delta" = 1 and "message_ledger_entries"."message_event_id" is null and "message_ledger_entries"."original_entry_id" is not null)
      or ("message_ledger_entries"."entry_kind" = 'revocation' and "message_ledger_entries"."package_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."delta" <= 0 and "message_ledger_entries"."message_event_id" is null and "message_ledger_entries"."original_entry_id" is not null)

message_ledger_admin_binding_complete.name: message_ledger_admin_binding_complete
message_ledger_admin_binding_complete.value:
("message_ledger_entries"."admin_approval_id" is null and "message_ledger_entries"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is null)
      or ("message_ledger_entries"."admin_approval_id" is not null and "message_ledger_entries"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is not null)

message_packages_admin_binding_complete.name: message_packages_admin_binding_complete
message_packages_admin_binding_complete.value:
("message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is null)
      or ("message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is not null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is not null)

message_packages_admin_contract.name: message_packages_admin_contract
message_packages_admin_contract.value:
("message_packages"."kind" = 'paid' and "message_packages"."legacy_admin_grant" = false and "message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is null)
      or ("message_packages"."kind" in ('admin', 'intro') and "message_packages"."legacy_admin_grant" = true and "message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is null)
      or ("message_packages"."kind" = 'admin' and "message_packages"."legacy_admin_grant" = false and "message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is not null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is not null and "message_packages"."granted_messages" in (500, 1000, 1500, 2000) and "message_packages"."expires_at" is not null)
      or ("message_packages"."kind" = 'intro' and "message_packages"."legacy_admin_grant" = false and "message_packages"."admin_approval_id" is not null and "message_packages"."admin_requester_session_id_hash" is not null and "message_packages"."granted_messages" = 100 and "message_packages"."expires_at" is null)

admin_approvals_binding_complete.name: admin_approvals_binding_complete
admin_approvals_binding_complete.value:
"admin_approvals"."requester_session_id_hash" = 'legacy-unbound' or (
        "admin_approvals"."requester_mfa_verified_at" is not null and (
          (
            "admin_approvals"."approver_id" is null and
            "admin_approvals"."approver_session_id_hash" is null and
            "admin_approvals"."approver_mfa_verified_at" is null and
            "admin_approvals"."approved_at" is null
          ) or (
            "admin_approvals"."approver_id" is not null and
            "admin_approvals"."approver_session_id_hash" is not null and
            "admin_approvals"."approver_mfa_verified_at" is not null and
            "admin_approvals"."approved_at" is not null
          )
        )
      )

admin_approvals_lifecycle_order.name: admin_approvals_lifecycle_order
admin_approvals_lifecycle_order.value:
"admin_approvals"."requester_session_id_hash" = 'legacy-unbound' or (
        "admin_approvals"."expires_at" > "admin_approvals"."created_at" and
        "admin_approvals"."requester_mfa_verified_at" <= "admin_approvals"."created_at" and
        ("admin_approvals"."approved_at" is null or (
          "admin_approvals"."approved_at" >= "admin_approvals"."created_at" and
          "admin_approvals"."approver_mfa_verified_at" <= "admin_approvals"."approved_at"
        )) and
        ("admin_approvals"."consumed_at" is null or (
          "admin_approvals"."approved_at" is not null and
          "admin_approvals"."consumed_at" >= "admin_approvals"."approved_at"
        ))
      )

public.package_balances.name: package_balances
public.package_balances.definition:
select p.id as package_id, p.user_id, coalesce(sum(l.delta), 0)::integer as balance
  from message_packages p
  left join message_ledger_entries l on l.package_id = p.id
  group by p.id, p.user_id

public.expert_referral_balances.name: expert_referral_balances
public.expert_referral_balances.definition:
with debt_offsets as (
    select reversal.source_id as grant_id,
      coalesce(sum(repayment.amount_minor), 0)::bigint as repaid_minor
    from expert_referral_ledger_entries repayment
    join expert_referral_ledger_entries reversal
      on reversal.id = repayment.original_entry_id
      and reversal.entry_kind = 'reversal'
    where repayment.entry_kind = 'debt_repayment'
    group by reversal.source_id
  ), grant_positions as (
    select
      g.id as grant_id,
      g.inviter_expert_id as expert_id,
      g.expires_at,
      coalesce(sum(
        case
          when l.entry_kind = 'release' then 0
          when l.entry_kind = 'debt_repayment' then -a.amount_minor
          when l.entry_kind = 'reservation' and exists (
            select 1
            from expert_referral_ledger_entries terminal
            where terminal.original_entry_id = l.id
              and terminal.entry_kind in ('release', 'spend')
          ) then 0
          when l.amount_minor < 0 then -a.amount_minor
          else a.amount_minor
        end
      ), 0)::bigint + coalesce(debt_offsets.repaid_minor, 0)::bigint as net_minor
    from expert_referral_reward_grants g
    left join expert_referral_ledger_allocations a on a.reward_grant_id = g.id
    left join expert_referral_ledger_entries l on l.id = a.ledger_entry_id
    left join debt_offsets on debt_offsets.grant_id = g.id
    group by g.id, g.inviter_expert_id, g.expires_at, debt_offsets.repaid_minor
  ), account_positions as (
    select
      e.id as expert_id,
      coalesce(sum(
        case
          when p.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
          then greatest(p.net_minor, 0)
          else 0
        end
      ), 0)::bigint as current_credit_minor,
      coalesce(sum(greatest(-p.net_minor, 0)), 0)::bigint as debt_minor,
      min(p.expires_at) filter (
        where p.expires_at > statement_timestamp() and p.net_minor > 0
      ) as nearest_expiry_at
    from experts e
    left join grant_positions p on p.expert_id = e.id
    group by e.id
  ), active_reservations as (
    select
      l.account_expert_id as expert_id,
      coalesce(sum(a.amount_minor), 0)::bigint as reserved_minor
    from expert_referral_ledger_entries l
    join expert_referral_ledger_allocations a on a.ledger_entry_id = l.id
    join expert_referral_reward_grants g on g.id = a.reward_grant_id
    where l.entry_kind = 'reservation'
      and g.expires_at > statement_timestamp()
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from expert_referral_ledger_entries terminal
        join expert_referral_ledger_allocations terminal_allocation
          on terminal_allocation.ledger_entry_id = terminal.id
          and terminal_allocation.reward_grant_id = a.reward_grant_id
        where terminal.original_entry_id = l.id
          and terminal.entry_kind in ('release', 'spend')
      )
    group by l.account_expert_id
  ), lifetime_totals as (
    select
      e.id as expert_id,
      coalesce(sum(l.amount_minor) filter (where l.entry_kind = 'reward_grant'), 0)::bigint as lifetime_granted_minor,
      coalesce(sum(-l.amount_minor) filter (where l.entry_kind = 'spend'), 0)::bigint as lifetime_spent_minor,
      coalesce(sum(-l.amount_minor) filter (where l.entry_kind = 'expiry'), 0)::bigint as lifetime_expired_minor
    from experts e
    left join expert_referral_ledger_entries l on l.account_expert_id = e.id
    group by e.id
  )
  select
    p.expert_id,
    case when p.debt_minor > 0 then 0 else p.current_credit_minor end::bigint as spendable_balance_minor,
    coalesce(r.reserved_minor, 0)::bigint as reserved_balance_minor,
    p.debt_minor,
    p.nearest_expiry_at,
    l.lifetime_granted_minor,
    l.lifetime_spent_minor,
    l.lifetime_expired_minor
  from account_positions p
  join lifetime_totals l on l.expert_id = p.expert_id
  left join active_reservations r on r.expert_id = p.expert_id
